name: Bird Dog
aliases: Quadruped Opposite Arm and Leg Reach
steps: Start on all fours on the floor with your wrists directly beneath your shoulders, knees beneath your hips, and spine neutral.
Brace your abs gently to lock your lower back and pelvis steady.
Extend one arm straight forward and your opposite leg straight behind you until both align horizontally with your torso.
Pause briefly with control, return both limbs beneath you, and alternate diagonal pairs on each repetition.
tips: Keep both hip bones facing squarely toward the floor instead of twisting your pelvis open.
Lift your leg only to hip height so your lower back does not arch downward.
